policy: East Asian tea vessels only; exclude all tea spoons, scoops and spoon-like variants; one distinct accession per record; image rights checked per source; transparent images visually reviewed.
visualReview: Compared each accepted cutout with its original. Items with museum stands, inventory tags, groups, missing parts, or visually redundant series were excluded.
processing: 1200x1200 lossless-alpha WebP, 10% margin. Previously reviewed images retain their recorded local segmentation model and processing hash; new additions use the same project cutout standard.
